verdict.rationale: Drata's API documents a multi-framework model in one platform: List Frameworks, Create Custom Framework, framework requirements, and control-to-requirement mappings with Compare Control Requirements. That implies many frameworks can be managed side by side, and custom ones added without a new tool. However, nothing in the pack names HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as supported out-of-the-box frameworks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prebuilt HIPAA/GDPR/PCI DSS frameworks, evidence of cross-framework control reuse for those standards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
